heading: Paint House: The DP Trick
body:
**3 houses × 3 colors = 3³ combos?** Nope. Track `dp[i][c]` = min cost to paint houses 0..i where house i is color c.

**Key:** Only 3n states exist (house × color), not 3ⁿ. Each state depends only on the previous row — no adjacent same color.

heading: The Recurrence in One Line
body:
`dp[i][RED] = costs[i][RED] + min(dp[i-1][BLUE], dp[i-1][GREEN])`

**Translation:** To paint house i red, pick the cheaper of {prev house blue, prev house green}. Same logic for other colors.

**Base:** `dp[0][c] = costs[0][c]` (first house has no constraint).

label: Crux · Python

q: What is the time complexity of the space-optimized solution?
explain: We iterate through n houses once, doing constant work (3 min operations) per house, giving O(n) time.
